description: This file defines the SlidingTabStrip class, a custom View component used for rendering tabs with indicator, divider, and underline graphics in an Android UI. It extends LinearLayout and manages drawing of visual elements based on tab selection and customization.

classes.name: SlidingTabStrip
classes.description: A custom linear layout that visualizes tab indicators, underlines, and dividers, and manages visual state updates for the tab layout.

classes.name: SlidingTabStrip.SimpleTabColorizer
classes.description: An internal class implementing TabColorizer to provide colors for indicators and dividers based on position.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom TabColorizer for customizing tab indicator and divider colors.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Sets the colors for the selected tab indicator.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Sets the colors for dividers between tabs.

methods.name: onViewPagerPageChanged
methods.description: Updates internal state based on the current ViewPager page and offset.
